open_text_result: No admissible reusable Greek text was verified for the FGrH dossier. DFHG exposes FHG II fragments 1–4 and is CC BY-SA 4.0, but its own documentation states that this text derives from OCR; it is excluded under the no-third-party-OCR rule.
scan_result: The precise historical counterpart is FHG II (1848), p. 343, documented for Menecrates Xanthius / FGrH 769. BSB/DDB supplies the matching scan but with a non-commercial reuse condition; no GitHub-compatible image source was verified.
scan_rights: DDB/BSB labels the exact FHG II digitization 'Kein Urheberrechtsschutz - Nur nicht kommerzielle Nutzung erlaubt'. No image is acquired. A Wikimedia PDM FHG file found is an 1868 item and was not assumed to contain the 1848 vol. II p.343 witness.
next_action: Map FGrH 769 T/F entries individually to their ancient source witnesses, seeking non-OCR open texts; separately locate a PDM/CC0 scan demonstrably containing FHG II p.343 before any image acquisition.
notes: Identity is securely Menecrates Xanthius (not the comic poet or the Menecrates of Samos/Smyrna); the relevant ancient work is Lyciaca. DFHG is retained only as a discovery/concordance aid, never as accepted text, because its stated OCR lineage conflicts with the task constraint.
